## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally / 本地测试通过
- [ ] New behavior has tests / 新行为有测试覆盖
- [ ] User-facing strings use `tr()` with English entries in `i18n._EN`
      / 用户可见文案走 `tr()` 并补了英文（见 CONTRIBUTING 第 5 条）
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed (README / README.en) / 行为变化已同步文档
